cases.title: Alias chain with a missing source anchor pair
cases.selection_rationale: Design section 16 mandatory case: the canned sidecar wire records free(q) as releasing the object allocated to b while the alias-copy fact for q carries no source anchor (the launder hop is outside the supported alias syntax), so P2 and P6 stay unknown and only the Specialist/Critic branch can decide; the fake LLM script supports the candidate with a real fact id and the fixed revision reads b->v before the release. Real-model runs must exercise this case non-zero-call evidence before claiming integration verification.
